newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Bergen Brunswig targets up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Bergen Brunswig targets up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it raised its price targets on Bergen Brunswig Corp shares to $34 from $30 for the next six months, and to $39 from $35 for the next 18 months.

-- "Our price target reflects the belief that Bergen can trade at parity to the S&P 500 during the next six months, a level that is consistent with historical valuation and an improving fundamental environment for the company and the drug-distribution industry," said analyst Kevin Silverman.
-- He maintains his outperformer rating on the company.
-- Bergen Brunswig was trading at 30-1/8, off 1/8.
